ns2:section.sectionText: Study Skills Course for Chemistry and Chemical Engineering Majors (1 credit) A second 8-week course for new students (freshman or transfer students) that are struggling in their coursework. This course focuses solely on study skills and goal setting, specifically in the context of these majors. Students will be identified by instructors, advisors, deans and self-selection by the student.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Chemical Engineering or Chemistry or Computer Sci & Chemistry major(s).
